annotations.title: Find live jobs near a place

description: Search US jobs that are live right now on employers' own careers sites (re-read on a schedule, retired within about 36 hours of leaving). Give what (title or keywords) and where (City, ST or ZIP), or remote_only. Returns up to 25 jobs with posted pay, what each posting asks for (education, licences, years), distance, when it was last confirmed, the employer's industry and size, the employer's own apply link, and a job_id for the whole posting. Only the filters given are applied; the "asks" are listed, never used to drop a job. To keep a daily feed for one person (e.g. from their resume), run the same search each day with posted_within_days=1, title_exclude for titles they do not want, and page through next_page.

min_pay.description: Minimum pay: annual, or hourly if under 300. Jobs that do not post pay are kept, listed last.

page.description: 25 jobs a page; pass next_page from the previous result

title_exclude.description: Comma-separated words; jobs whose title contains any of them are left out, e.g. "senior, travel"

what.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "registered nurse", "forklift"

name: search_live_jobs
